notes.title: Home Snatch Walkthrough Part 3
notes.content:
[b]Hi, friends![/b] 👋

Here’s today's walkthrough for you:


[b]1.Enter the house[/b] 

Use the key found in the drawer to open the door to the room. 🔑
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45125184/5af0e3501160a1f0b311da5b80980b818c30ac61.gif[/img]


[b]2.Where is my head?[/b] 

Grab the head from the fridge, and hurry!  Put it on the body on the third floor before someone finds you. 🧟‍♂️
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45125184/14b8607ea6ab04cce4d43fc341e0199f7aace611.gif[/img]


[b]3.Enter the factory [/b]🏭

The main gate is locked, but no worries, we can go in through the lamppost on the side. 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45125184/cb206c97b0e89f7eac90dbdacdd5c1237a4b2de2.gif[/img]


[b]4.Where should I go? [/b]🗺️

The destination is at the top right of the factory. Go straight through the gate, turn right at the truck 🚚, go to the end, turn left, and then left again to enter the workshop. 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45125184/e6701ce2f08b0cea2b2a4b296e9b477be6e5be52.gif[/img]


[b]5.Hostage found![/b] 🚨

Go up the stairs to see what’s going on. If you encounter danger, remember to run away! 🏃‍♀️
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45125184/3a18a1b00d6a7542f48e1534df83db03720f35cd.gif[/img]


[b]Enjoy the game! [/b]

If you have any feedback, feel free to reach out to us anytime. 📧
Thank you!

notes.title: Home Snatch Walkthrough Part 2
notes.content:
[b]Hi, friends![/b] 👋

Here’s the second part of the Home Snatch Walkthrough, check it out. 📜
After we escaped from the truck last time… 🚚💨


[b]1.We saw a gas station, but where to go now? [/b]

Behind the gas station⛽, there’s a bridge. Walk through it and remember: DON’T GO BACK! 🚫
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45125184/959c38c51ccb994c7a09e23ace8d8be99c84aaee.gif[/img]


[b]2.Trapped in the basement [/b]

Use the wheel next to the cabinet to open the door and leave the basement. 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45125184/c958f1c1ba7ca14728b45e7998a8e348d04b9a03.gif[/img]


[b]3.Monster in the water [/b]

Worried about a monster chasing after you? 🏃‍♂️Press SHIFT to speed up your steps. 💨At the end of the tunnel, you will see a door. 🚪
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45125184/6fc0ced9aa190fc08eb06ff4fa120d4af12cea20.gif[/img]


[b]4.A perfect hiding spot[/b]

Hide in the corn🌽 until the man in black leaves. 👀
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45125184/fa8334cebb50b3c48213698d5e18f446136ceaea.gif[/img]


[b]5.Blocked door [/b]

What do we do when we can’t enter a house through the front door? Use the side door. ➡️
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45125184/f1a46783af3f068d069383e8b99ddcd1c55f34b4.gif[/img]


[b]Enjoy the game![/b] 🎮

If you have any feedback, feel free to reach out to us anytime. 📧
Thank you!

notes.title: Home Snatch walkthrough Part 1
notes.content:
Hi friends! It's been a few days since Home Snatch was released on Steam, have you completed it yet?
[b]Here are some tips to help you get the most out of the game. [/b]🔮Check them out and let's get started now!


[b]1.Wandering around the room, wondering where to go?[/b]🤔

Outside your flat, at the end of the corridor, there's a power control room. Go there and see what will happen.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45125184/2f873b2e3dfe15a013f12386aa7deaf5359499d9.gif[/img]


[b]2.Who cut the power?[/b]

Ouch! My head hurts, perhaps we need a nap😪, but don't forget to call the police🚔 before you go to bed.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45125184/533e535dfba4d050d18e88fda6321ef3ccada770.gif[/img]


[b]3.A mystery visitor[/b]

Someone broke into my house🥷, but the door of my bedroom is jammed! Don't worry, check the balcony next to the bed and cross it to reach the living room.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45125184/761b0b2ae4f52e24946d6fe660ecfda18a9171f7.gif[/img]


[b]4.Heading towards the light[/b]🔦

What a mess my living room is! And...Hey, why is there light in the bathroom, go see what's going on.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45125184/1691ae83269a00cddfdba6ca1f26204525f3d0af.gif[/img]


[b]5.Have I been kidnapped?[/b]

There seems to have happened an accident to the kidnapper's car, drag these pieces of furniture to make yourself a way out of the truck.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45125184/89c87710a2c04748e99a000aa4eb78eab587131c.gif[/img]


[b]Feel free to contact us if you have any feedback[/b]🤗

Hope you enjoy the game and see you in the next walkthrough!
